verdict.rationale: Copilot code review comments on pull requests with High/Medium/Low severity labels and one-click suggested fixes (docs-28, docs-29). The desktop workspace lets you review changes and merge them (docs-8), agent mode validates files (docs-22), and Autofix flags and fixes vulnerabilities (docs-13). Together these cover catching problems before merge. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a diff-inspection UI, clear evidence of running tests or CI checks before merge, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
